prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 4:5 editorial cover image for a Japanese boat-racing social post
Primary request: A photorealistic late-afternoon Japanese kyotei motorboat race on an urban riverside course with warm low sunlight and light ripples. Two or three boats form a close pack exiting a turn.
Scene/backdrop: urban riverside racecourse, subtly atmospheric and unbranded, warm late-day light; keep the top 45% dark, calm, and visually uncluttered for later title overlay.
Subject: Authentic Japanese kyotei racing boats, each a single-seat craft about 3 m long, flat, low, and long relative to its racer, with a white or pale-grey hull. Each has an open cockpit only—no canopy, no roof, no bubble windshield. Each racer crouches or kneels very low, leans forward, and holds a small steering wheel with both hands. Racers wear plain full-face helmets and plain racing suits; faces are fully hidden. Exactly one outboard motor at each stern creates a large white spray plume.
Style/medium: high-end natural sports photography, believable proportions and mechanics, crisp water spray, no stylization.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5; boats entirely in the lower half, dynamic close pack leaving the turn; top 45% remains dark and uncluttered.
Lighting/mood: warm low late-afternoon sunlight, energetic but natural.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: no recognizable real person; all boats must clearly read as authentic Japanese kyotei craft rather than offshore powerboats or F1 tunnel boats.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, signage, boat-number plates, flags, banners, emblems, decals, or readable markings anywhere. No canopy, roof, enclosed cockpit, windshield bubble, offshore powerboat form, or F1 tunnel boat form.

verification.method: visual inspection of the generated image
verification.notes: Visually inspected at full image view. The image shows three low, long, light-colored, open-cockpit kyotei racing boats in a close pack exiting a turn on an urban riverside course in warm late-afternoon light. All racers crouch low in plain full-face helmets with faces hidden. Each boat has one stern outboard motor and a white spray plume. The boats occupy the lower half and the upper 45% is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, or recognizable real person are visible.
